name: Flame Blade
description:
You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals 2d6 + 4 fire damage on a hit, and you make melee spell attacks when you attack with it. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a Minor Action. The flaming blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 ft.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every slot level above 2nd.
